def _get_import_module(self) -> Module:
    empty_code = libcst.parse_module("")
    context = CodemodContext()
    for import_item in self.import_items_to_be_moved:
        if import_item.obj_name:
            AddImportsVisitor.add_needed_import(context, import_item.module_name, import_item.obj_name)
        else:
            AddImportsVisitor.add_needed_import(context, import_item.module_name)
    transformer = AddImportsVisitor(context)
    transformed_source_module = transformer.transform_module(empty_code)
    return transformed_source_module
